question: What nurturing and auspicious form of the goddess protects the speaker always?
premises: The goddess is mother of the world's delight.
She has the form of Śambhu.
She is invoked to protect the speaker always.
inference: The goddess, mother of worldly delight and of Śambhu's form, is asked to protect always.
plain_english: May the mother who brings delight to the world, having the form of Śambhu, always protect me.
